2609.02685.title: DKL: Decoupled Knowledge Learning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models
2609.02685.paper_summary: RAG has become the de facto method for incorporating new, corpus-specific knowledge into an instruction following LLM (Instruct LLM). Although RAG-based prompting improves factual grounding, it fails when retrieval is incorrect or incomplete, leading to hallucinations. Finetuning methods such as RAFT and PA-RAG enhance RAG by injecting new knowledge into the model's parameters, but require generating a massive amount of synthetic QA that covers the entire corpus. Extended Pre-Training (EPT) on the text corpus avoids the need for comprehensive synthetic data generation but compromises an Instruct LLM's instruction-following capabilities, necessitating instruction fine-tuning (IFT) after pre-training. However, IFT is costly and may be infeasible due to the unavailability of an instruction-tuning corpus. In this work, we propose DKL-Decoupled Knowledge Learning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models. Instead of doing EPT on the Instruct LLM, DKL performs EPT on its corresponding base LLM to infuse new knowledge. These knowledge infused weights are then merged with the Instruct LLM, imparting new knowledge without affecting their instruction-following capabilities. DKL is a lightweight method that avoids expensive instruction fine-tuning and relies on model merging to infuse the new knowledge into the Instruct LLM without destroying its instruction following capabilities. Empirical results show that DKL improves RAG accuracy from 54.17 to 79.26 on retrieval failure cases, while outperforming prior approaches with substantially less training data.
2609.02685.paper_summary_zh: RAG 已成為將新的、特定語料庫的知識納入指令跟隨 LLM（Instruct LLM）的事實上方法。<lb/>雖然基於 RAG 的提示改善了事實基礎，但當檢索不正確或不完整時，它會失敗，導致幻覺。<lb/>微調方法如 RAFT 和 PA-RAG 通過將新知識注入模型的參數來增強 RAG，但需要生成大量涵蓋整個語料庫的合成 QA。<lb/>在文本語料庫上進行擴展預訓練（EPT）避免了對全面合成數據生成的需求，但會妨礙 Instruct LLM 的指令跟隨能力，因此在預訓練後需要進行指令微調（IFT）。<lb/>然而，IFT 成本高昂，並且由於缺乏指令調整語料庫，可能不可行。<lb/>在本研究中，我們提出了 DKL-解耦知識學習，用於指令調整的語言模型。<lb/>DKL 不是在 Instruct LLM 上進行 EPT，而是在其相應的基礎 LLM 上進行 EPT 以注入新知識。<lb/>這些注入知識的權重然後與 Instruct LLM 合併， imparting 新知識而不影響其指令跟隨能力。<lb/>DKL 是一種輕量級的方法，避免了昂貴的指令微調，並依賴模型合併將新知識注入 Instruct LLM，而不破壞其指令跟隨能力。<lb/>實證結果顯示，DKL 在檢索失敗案例中將 RAG 的準確率從 54.17 提高到 79.26，同時以顯著更少的訓練數據超越了先前的方法。
